claim: There is no thermometer beside the sample. The only thermometer in the laboratory reads the room, so any temperature attributed to the sample is a room reading applied to it.
validity_conditions: This laboratory as of 2026-09-19, read by the operator. It REPLACES an inference: lab_ambient_temperature reasoned that its value could only be the room's, from the fact that nothing actuates the sample. The same conclusion is now stated, which is a stronger claim than a consequence of an absence, and it is why the sample-adjacent reading stops being an open question. What it does NOT say is how far the room thermometer is from the sample or how well the two track -- neither is known, and an unknown distance is not a small one. Falsified by putting a thermometer at the sample, which is also what would close the two questions it leaves open.
